findings.message: Credentials or environment variables flow to a network sink. This is a high-confidence indicator of credential exfiltration.
findings.pattern: Tainted flow: 'req' from os.environ.get (line 186, credential/environment) → urllib.request.urlopen (network output)
findings.remediation: Never send credentials or environment variables over the network. Use secure credential stores and avoid transmitting secrets in request bodies or URLs.
